metadata.purpose: Prove that a human correction becomes shared memory for a new browser agent session.
metadata.learner_outcome: By the end, the viewer can verify the WebMCP search/read flow, human authorization, Git revision, and fresh-session readback.
metadata.source_policy: Use real deployed UI and real tool operations as evidence; use no fabricated UI.
metadata.publication_target: Public YouTube demo under three minutes with clear audio.

beats.teaching_purpose: Establish the live product and the single result the viewer will verify.
beats.spoken_content: This is HatWiki, a live Git-native Wiki where people and browser agents maintain shared knowledge together. In this short demo, a human correction becomes readable to a new agent session through WebMCP.

narration_spine.name: English opening and outcome pickup
narration_spine.production_method: Record a human voiceover after the live URL and WebMCP host are verified.
narration_spine.acceptance: The opening names HatWiki, the live environment, and the concrete outcome without introducing unused features.

visual_slots.name: Live HatWiki home and Knowledge Loom
visual_slots.production_method: Capture the deployed HatWiki home page without private browser data.
visual_slots.acceptance: The live URL, HatWiki identity, and Knowledge Loom are readable.

beats.teaching_purpose: Show the existing page and define the human-facing task before the Agent acts.
beats.spoken_content: Our task is to improve an existing human-written research page, preserve its evidence boundary, and make the corrected result available to a new agent session. A person can browse the same page as a normal Wiki, with citations and related links.

narration_spine.name: English task setup pickup
narration_spine.production_method: Record a concise task statement over the selected Wiki page and its source context.
narration_spine.acceptance: The existing page, source context, and fresh-session success condition are all understandable.

visual_slots.name: Agent2UCB page and citation context
visual_slots.production_method: Capture the public Wiki index, Agent2UCB page, citation, and table of contents.
visual_slots.acceptance: The selected page is visibly existing and source-aware, not a generated placeholder.

beats.teaching_purpose: Prove that the browser Agent discovers and reads the page through the WebMCP surface.
beats.spoken_content: Find the existing Agent2UCB page using HatWiki's tools. Then read it and summarize its evidence boundary in three bullets. WebMCP lets the Agent search first and read the canonical page instead of guessing from temporary conversation context.

narration_spine.name: English WebMCP explanation pickup
narration_spine.production_method: Record human narration after a real WebMCP host completes search_wiki followed by read_page.
narration_spine.acceptance: The recording visibly proves both tool calls and shows the page ID, short search result, citations, and revision.

visual_slots.name: WebMCP search and read evidence
visual_slots.production_method: Capture the real external Agent host and redact private session details.
visual_slots.acceptance: search_wiki and read_page names, inputs, and bounded results are readable.

beats.teaching_purpose: Make the safety boundary, approved write, and durable revision visible in one continuous sequence.
beats.spoken_content: Propose one small clarification, but do not publish until I approve the exact text. I approve this exact sentence. Publish it to HatWiki using edit_page. After approval, the authenticated server validates the change and records a Git-backed revision.

narration_spine.name: English approval and write-path pickup
narration_spine.production_method: Record the agent proposal, explicit human approval, authenticated edit_page call, and result in one controlled take.
narration_spine.acceptance: The agent stops before the write, the approval is explicit, and the result status, revision, and Git commit or diff are visible.

visual_slots.name: Proposed clarification, edit_page, and Git revision
visual_slots.production_method: Capture the real authenticated write flow, then show public readback and the GitHub revision without exposing credentials.
visual_slots.acceptance: The result is verifiable as committed, not merely a success message fabricated in the video.

unresolved_work.name: Gate A write-flow evidence
unresolved_work.production_method: Complete and test the visible authenticated edit flow, including preview or minimal diff and committed/conflict/approval_required result.
unresolved_work.acceptance: A real external WebMCP host can complete the write using the same signed-in session.

beats.teaching_purpose: Prove that the new state is shared memory rather than context hidden in the first Agent session.
beats.spoken_content: Now I open a fresh agent session. It can read the corrected page, its citation, and the new revision without inheriting the previous conversation. The shared memory is the Wiki and Git history, not the chat transcript.

narration_spine.name: English fresh-session validation and closing pickup
narration_spine.production_method: Record a new browser-Agent session reading the updated public page, then close on the updated page and Knowledge Loom.
narration_spine.acceptance: The fresh session reads the corrected sentence and reports the current revision and source; the close states the human/Agent boundary.

visual_slots.name: Fresh-session readback and final Knowledge Loom
visual_slots.production_method: Capture a genuinely new session and the updated public page after commit, GitHub readback, and R2 publication.
visual_slots.acceptance: The second session visibly reads the new state without relying on the first session's transcript.

unresolved_work.name: Gate C fresh-session evidence
unresolved_work.production_method: Run the complete write, public readback, and fresh WebMCP session against the deployed revision.
unresolved_work.acceptance: The updated page, citation, and revision are available to a new session.
